messages:
ana: TidalHealth RFI arrived. They need capability matrix, pilot pricing split (base+overage), POC schedule, and security answers. Can we bundle by tomorrow EOD?
raj: Ican own matrix + model compat. Will include quant profiles and region pinning notes.
kevin: Ill draft POC runbook and sample infra config (VPC peering + SSO). Need target QPS and typical response length from them.
security-bot: SOC2 Type II cert available (link: https://internal.redwood/docs/soc2). BYOK supported in Private, Dedicated supports customer-managed KMS. Reminder: redact any PII.
ana: Procurement wants pilot split: monthly reserved + burst overage. Kevin, can you propose numbers?
kevin: Proposal: $10k/mo reserved for pilot (2 vGPUs), $0.10/1k tokens overage, optional 24x7 support add-on. Will share CSV.
raj: Adding a fallback row: if Dedicated >80% utilization, route to hosted eu region with model variant. Documented in matrix.
ana: Also attach a short console demo (2 min) showing tracing and rollout. Could be decisive for ops team.
kevin: Uploaded demo: https://drive.redwood/tidal-demo.mp4
raj: Capability matrix draft: https://drive.redwood/tidal-cap-matrix-v2.xlsx (includes latency samples: 95p ~ 200ms @256 tokens on p4d with 8-batch).
security-bot: Note: Default audit log retention 90d for POC, extendable. Provide region pinning confirmation for EU.
ana: Good. Ill compile final zip: matrix + pricing CSV + security answers + runbook + demo. Will post here when ready.
